items.title: 钉钉北京峰会展示AI落地多行业样本，一批企业集中签约
items.raw_excerpt: 2月3日，以“AI时代的工作方式”为主题的钉峰会在北京隆重举行。雷峰网获悉，峰会由阿里巴巴钉钉和中关村国际共同举办，汇聚了来自制造业、农业、供应链、环保、文媒等多行业的领军企业代表、数字化先锋及专家逾三百人，深入探讨人工智能浪潮下工作方式的重塑与进化。 现场，一批北京区域企业与钉钉集中签约，共同迈入AI时代的工作方式，包括博锐尚格科技股份有限公司、天津市神州商龙科技股份有限公司、北京健坤餐饮集团、北京央视瑞安技术服务有限公司等。 智能体操作系统：从工具到伙伴的进化 钉钉华北大区总经理刘浩在致辞中指出，当前正处在AI转型的关键时间点。钉钉以解决真实问题为原点，致力于从传统的应用平台升级为面向未来的“智能体操作系统”（Agent OS）。他强调，AI时代的工作方式需要根本性的重新思考，即从“人操作工具”转向“人调教AI”，让智能体（Agent）成为业务执行与协同的核心单元。 钉钉华北大区总经理刘浩 中关村国际控股有限公司总经理卢江表示，中关村国际正通过覆盖全球的创新网络，携手钉钉，以AI为纽带、出海服务为桥梁，共同优化AI时代的服务模式，让创新价值在全球范围内绽放。 钉钉华北大区解决方案总经理刘啸天在主题分享中阐释了“智能体协同”的核心逻辑。他认为，AI规模化落地的关键瓶颈不再是模型能力，而在于缺乏企业级统一的运行环境。钉钉正以Agent OS为内核，构建下一代操作系统，通过智能体统一调度数字工具与物理设备，并实现智能体间的交互与协同。人在这一系统中的角色，从执行者转变为“教练”，负责调教与设定目标，而将重复性、流程化的工作交由智能体执行。 全网爆火的钉钉首款AI硬件DingTalk A1录音卡也在本次峰会上亮相，A1产品负责人夏治朋详细介绍了这款“网红”产品设计的初衷和用户自发探索出的花式用法，现场种草。 跨界实践：AI赋能千行百业，客户亲述转型心声 峰会邀请了多位来自一线企

On February 3, the DingTalk Summit themed "Work Styles in the AI Era" was grandly held in Beijing. According to Leifeng.com, the summit was jointly organized by Alibaba's DingTalk and Zhongguancun International, bringing together over 300 representatives from leading enterprises, digital pioneers, and experts across various industries such as manufacturing, agriculture, supply chain, environmental protection, and culture and media. They engaged in in-depth discussions on the reshaping and evolution of work styles under the wave of artificial intelligence.  

At the event, a group of Beijing-based companies signed centralized agreements with DingTalk to jointly embrace AI-era work styles, including Borui Shangge Technology Co., Ltd., Tianjin Shenzhou Shanglong Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Jiankun Catering Group, and Beijing CCTV Ruian Technical Service Co., Ltd.  

**Intelligent Agent Operating System: Evolution from Tool to Partner**  
Liu Hao, General Manager of DingTalk's North China Region, emphasized in his speech that the current moment is a critical juncture for AI transformation. With a focus on solving real-world problems, DingTalk is committed to upgrading from a traditional application platform to a future-oriented "Intelligent Agent Operating System" (Agent OS). He stressed that work styles in the AI era require fundamental rethinking—shifting from "humans operating tools" to "humans training AI," making intelligent agents the core units for business execution and collaboration.  

Lu Jiang, General Manager of Zhongguancun International Holdings Co., Ltd., stated that Zhongguancun International, through its global innovation network, is collaborating with DingTalk to optimize service models in the AI era, using AI as a link and overseas services as a bridge to unleash the value of innovation worldwide.

En el evento, un grupo de empresas de la región de Beijing firmó acuerdos colectivos con DingTalk, avanzando juntas hacia las formas de trabajo en la era de la IA, incluyendo Borui Shangge Technology Co., Ltd., Tianjin Shenzhou Shanglong Technology Co., Ltd., Beijing Jiankun Catering Group y Beijing CCTV Ruian Technical Service Co., Ltd. items.raw_excerpt: 在大语言模型逐步从通用推理工具走向专业领域应用的过程中，运筹优化（OR）成为一个极具吸引力、同时也极具挑战性的方向。 一方面，运筹优化问题天然具备清晰的数学结构和可验证的求解结果，看似非常适合由模型自动完成建模与求解；另一方面，真实运筹建模高度依赖变量定义、约束设计与目标函数之间的整体一致性，其推理过程往往呈现出强步骤依赖和强耦合特征，远非算出一个正确答案所能覆盖。 正是在这一张力之下，当前运筹建模大模型研究逐渐暴露出一个核心困境：模型在求解器层面得到正确结果，并不意味着其完成了正确的建模。在现有主流训练范式中，无论是仅依据最终求解结果进行奖励，还是对中间步骤进行局部、逐步的过程监督，都难以准确刻画运筹建模这种长链条推理任务的真实质量。 这种监督信号与任务本质之间的错位，使得建模错误可能被掩盖，甚至被反复强化，逐渐成为大模型走向工业级运筹优化应用的关键瓶颈。在这样的研究背景下，来自上海交通大学智能计算研究院葛冬冬、林江浩研究团队提出了《StepORLM: A Self-Evolving Framework with Generative Process Supervision for Operations Research Language Models》。 这项研究并未仅从模型规模或数据量入手，而是从训练范式本身出发，系统性反思了结果奖励与传统过程监督在运筹建模任务中的根本局限，并提出了一种由策略模型与生成式过程奖励模型（GenPRM）协同进化的自进化训练框架。通过将最终求解结果与对完整推理过程的回顾式、全局评估相结合，StepORLM 试图引导模型真正学习如何构建一致、可靠的运筹优化模型，而不仅仅是生成一个可行解。 论文地址：https://arxiv.org/abs/2509.22558 小模型，赢在方法 在实验评估方面，这项研究在 6 个具有代表性的运筹优化基准数据

On one hand, OR problems inherently possess clear mathematical structures and verifiable solutions, making them seemingly well-suited for automated modeling and solving by models. On the other hand, real-world OR modeling heavily relies on the overall consistency among variable definitions, constraint design, and objective functions, with reasoning processes often exhibiting strong step-dependency and high coupling—far beyond merely computing a correct answer. It is precisely under this tension that current research on large OR modeling models has revealed a core dilemma: a model obtaining correct results at the solver level does not necessarily mean it has performed correct modeling. Under existing mainstream training paradigms, whether rewarding based solely on final results or providing localized, step-by-step supervision of intermediate steps, it remains difficult to accurately capture the true quality of long-chain reasoning tasks like OR modeling. This misalignment between supervision signals and the task’s essence allows modeling errors to be concealed or even repeatedly reinforced, gradually becoming a key bottleneck in scaling large models toward industrial-level OR applications. In 2026, the artificial intelligence industry stands at a critical crossroads. On one hand, the "Scaling Law" dividends of general large models are nearing their peak, with capital heavily focused on world models. On the other hand, the fragmentation and non-standardization of industrial scenarios pose significant challenges for AI implementation. Against this backdrop, a seminar themed "Breaking Through with Applications, Uniting Ecosystems" was quietly held in Beijing, featuring the industrial internet company Wanlian Yida and its comprehensive industrial AI large model, "Wanlian Moore."  

At the event, the "Industrial Artificial Intelligence Research and Application Expert Committee" was officially inaugurated, led by Sun Maosong, Executive Vice Dean of the Institute for Artificial Intelligence at Tsinghua University and a Foreign Fellow of the European Academy of Sciences. The committee brings together AI research expertise from top universities such as Harbin Institute of Technology, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing Institute of Technology, and Northeastern University, signaling a joint effort to advance the future development and application of Wanlian Moore.  

Sun Maosong serves as the chief advisor of the Industrial Artificial Intelligence Research and Application Expert Committee.  

The next phase of "AI + Industry" is no longer about isolated technological breakthroughs but focuses on industrial applications, aiming to address the structural mismatch between fragmented scenarios and systemic capabilities.  

In the past, vertical large models were rapidly deployed in fields such as finance, healthcare, and agriculture, but most remained at the stage of "question-and-answer assistants," falling far short of the ideal "AI productivity expectations." Real-world industrial decisions often lack clear problem boundaries. For example, "How to expand the Inner Mongolia lamb trade to Xuzhou, where demand is high?" involves multidimensional variables such as supply chains, local dietary culture, and brand influence.
